target.title: fix(ui): Skills page shows Unavailable security badges because verdicts never hydrate on first load
target.body:
Closes #108647

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the Control UI Skills page showed a yellow **Unavailable** security badge for linked ClawHub skills on first load, even when the gateway's `skills.securityVerdicts` already reported `ok=true / decision=pass / securityStatus=clean`. The badge implied a broken or unverified skill when only the UI's verdict cache was empty.

## Why This Change Was Made

The route loader hydrates the `skills.status` report but never fetches security verdicts, and `ensureInitialData()` short-circuits once route data is present — so the only code path that populates `clawhubVerdicts` (`loadSkills` → `loadClawHubSecurityVerdicts`) never ran on first paint. Additionally nothing retried: if the verdict loader ran while `connected` was transiently false it cleared the map silently.

The fix exports the existing `loadClawHubSecurityVerdicts` helper and (1) calls it from `applyRouteData()` whenever the route provides a report, reusing the exact production loader (no-linked-skills fast path, agent-scope guards, error handling included), and (2) backfills from `ensureInitialData()` — invoked on every gateway state change — whenever a report is loaded but the verdict map is empty; the helper's early return keeps this RPC-free when no linked ClawHub skills exist.

The branch is rebuilt on current `main` after the Web Awesome Control UI refactor (#106865): the earlier revision of this PR also fixed `applyRouteData()` copying a stale loader-time `connected:false` over the live connection state, which is exactly the "client present while `connected === false`" observation in the issue; `main` now reads `connected` from the live gateway snapshot itself, so that part of the fix is already absorbed and no longer in this diff.

Follow-up from review: while the verdict fetch is actually in flight, linked-skill badges now render the existing **Pending** state (neutral styling) instead of **Unavailable**, so an in-progress verification is never presented as a failed or unavailable security state. Only a settled empty verdict map reads as Unavailable. No new i18n keys (reuses `skillsPage.verdict.pending`).

## User Impact

Skills page security badges are correct on first load: clean linked ClawHub skills show **Clean** instead of a false **Unavailable**, including when route data races the gateway connection. No extra RPC when no linked ClawHub skills exist.

## Evidence

**Real Control UI runs** (real gateway `openclaw gateway run --dev` with isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, real ClawHub skill installed via `openclaw skills install karpathy-coding-guidelines`, backend verdict confirmed via `openclaw gateway call skills.securityVerdicts` → `decision:"pass"`, `securityStatus:"clean"`; macOS, Node 24.18):

- **Before:** navigating to `/skills` rendered the skill card with badge **Unavailable**; live page state showed `verdictKeys=[]`, `verdictsError=null` while the gateway verdict was clean — hydration was simply never triggered.
- **After (current head, on the post-refactor page):** the same navigation renders **Ready / Clean** for the linked skill; live page state: `connected=true`, `verdictKeys=["https://clawhub.ai / karpathy-coding-guidelines / 1.0.0"]`, `verdictsError=null`, `reportSkills=58`.

**Automated coverage** — the route-data page test fails without the `applyRouteData()` hydration call (verified by temporarily disabling it) and passes with it:

```
pnpm test ui/src/pages/skills/skills-page.test.ts ui/src/lib/skills/index.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  41 passed (41)

pnpm tsgo:test:ui   # clean
pnpm ui:build       # clean
```

- `ui/src/pages/skills/skills-page.test.ts` (new): a route-provided report hydrates verdicts; `ensureInitialData()` backfills an empty verdict map when a report is already loaded.
- `ui/src/pages/skills/view.test.ts`: a linked skill renders **Pending** (and not Unavailable) while `clawhubVerdictsLoading` is true, and still renders **Unavailable** for a settled empty verdict map. Full UI suite green: 306 files / 4363 tests.
- `ui/src/lib/skills/index.test.ts`: the exported helper issues one `skills.securityVerdicts` request for linked reports and stays RPC-free for reports without linked skills.

**On the red `checks-node-compact-small-2` shard:** the failure is a single `src/tui/tui-pty-local.e2e.test.ts` timeout ("timed out waiting for PTY exit") — a TUI PTY e2e path this UI-only diff does not touch. The same file passes locally on this branch with a fresh build and clean test state: 10/10 tests green.

Note: contributor checkout without Crabbox/Testbox access; the Control UI runs above are real local gateway + browser sessions on this branch.
